item.title: Shizuoka Events 2026: Hamamatsu Kites, Fukuroi Fireworks & Mt Fuji
item.description: Shizuoka stretches from the slopes of Mt Fuji to the beaches of the Izu Peninsula, and its 2026 event calendar is as varied as its geography: giant kites battling over Hamamatsu’s dunes in spring, one of Japan’s premier fireworks competitions in summer, marine fireworks over Atami Bay across much of the year, and Japan’s earliest cherry blossoms on the Izu coast. Add the climbing season on Fuji itself, and Shizuoka rewards a well-timed 2026 trip.

item.title: Fuji Shibazakura Festival: A Carpet of Pink Moss Phlox Beneath Fuji — Guide
item.description: The Fuji Shibazakura Festival is held each spring near Lake Motosuko at the foot of Mount Fuji, when hundreds of thousands of shibazakura (moss phlox) plants bloom in sweeping carpets of pink, white and purple across the ground, set directly beneath the snow-capped mountain. Running roughly from mid-April to late May, it is one of Japan’s most spectacular flower festivals, with the low-growing blooms creating a vivid foreground to Fuji, alongside food stalls, viewpoints and photo spots that draw large crowds during its short season.
